chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from al-Saqr ibn Dulaf. He said: I heard my master Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ali al-Rida (peace be upon him) say:

Whoever has a need from God (Blessed and Exalted) should visit the grave of my grandfather al-Rida (peace be upon him) in Tus in a state of ghusl (ritual bath), pray two units at his head, and ask God for his need in his qunut — and it will be fulfilled for him as long as he does not ask for a sin or for severing family ties.
Truly, the place of his grave is a plot from the plots of Paradise. No believer visits it except that God frees him from the Fire and brings him into the Abode of Eternal Settlement.

key_terms.بقعة من الجنة: A plot of Paradise — the sacred ground of the shrine is spiritually identified with Paradise
key_terms.دار القرار: The Abode of Eternal Settlement — Paradise, the permanent dwelling of the blessed
key_terms.غسل الزيارة: Ritual bathing (ghusl) performed before visiting a holy shrine
key_terms.قبر الرضا: The grave of Imam al-Rida (AS) in Tus (present-day Mashhad), a major pilgrimage site
key_terms.قنوت: Qunut — a supplication recited while standing in the second unit of prayer

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hadi say about visiting the grave of Imam al-Rida in Tus?
ai.summary: Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS), the tenth Imam, instructs believers that visiting the grave of his grandfather Imam al-Rida (AS) in Tus — after performing ghusl and praying two units with supplications in qunut — is a powerful means of having one's lawful needs fulfilled by God. He further declares that the burial site itself is a portion of Paradise, and that any believer who visits it will be freed from Hellfire and admitted to the everlasting abode. This narration, recorded by al-Shaykh al-Saduq in 368 AH, reflects the Shia theological emphasis on the sanctity of the Imams' shrines as spiritual gateways to divine mercy.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather from al-Saqr b. Dulf He said: I heard my master `Ali b. Muhammad b. `Ali al-Rida (as) say:

Whoever has a need from Allah should visit the grave of my grandfather al-Rida (as) in Tus after having bathed. Then, he should pray two units at his head and ask Allah for his need in his qunut, and it will be fulfilled for him as long as he is not asking for depravity or severing blood ties.
Surely, the place where he is buried is a plot in Paradise. No believer visits it except that Allah frees him from the Fire and brings him into the Abode of Resolution.
